idea:
Every platform shift mints consumer giants. The web gave us Google + Airbnb. Mobile gave us Instagram + DoorDash. AI is the biggest shift YET. But three years in, the only new icon on your home screen is ChatGPT.

So why do we think NOW is a great time to build AI-powered consumer products? Intelligence just got good enough: you can treat an agent like a person. And it's about to get cheap enough, too: today, the magic can run $1,000 a month in tokens for each user, but that is falling 10x a year. Follow the curve, and you can predict the consumer moment: it lands very soon. Whoever builds now, owns it.

What do you build? How we get things done, get around, learn, stay healthy, manage our money, play, connect with friends. It all opens up again.

CONSUMER is going to be so back. If you're building for a billion people, we'd love to hear from you.

brand.name: Home Screen
brand.tagline: The race for the next billion-user icon.
brand.audience: Maverick consumer founders building the next generation of AI-native giants.
brand.visualConcept: A physical-feeling, dark-mode grid resembling an empty mobile home screen, where blank icon slots slowly illuminate with vibrant, generative neon-coral silhouettes as the user scrolls down the cost-curve.
brand.layout: A high-impact, single-column editorial scroll featuring massive, brutalist typography, an interactive 'cost-per-token' slider, and a hyper-minimalist pitch submission portal.
creativeNotes: Build an interactive SVG cost-curve graph that dynamically scales down 10x as the user scrolls, triggering a visual 'unlock' animation when it hits the current year.
Use a CSS grid with 'perspective' and 'rotateX' to create a 3D-tilted home screen mockup that straightens out and becomes interactive on scroll.
Optimize performance by using system font stacks styled with ultra-black weights (e.g., Impact or Arial Black) to avoid the loading lag of heavy custom web fonts.
